note: LTV is loan_amount / property_value * 100. Missing, Exempt, and non-positive property values are excluded. Each band includes its top value. Values above 80 and up to 80.25 stay in 60-80. Over 100 is above 100 through 400. Average total loan costs uses total_loan_costs; NA and Exempt are excluded. total_points_and_fees is too sparse on closed-end first liens.
